services.name: Tandem Flight
services.desc: You will fly with North America’s MOST EXPERIENCED TANDEM PILOTS. Our instructors are certified, professional, and available 7 days per week. They make their living providing YOU with a safe and exhilarating experience. Our record is impeccable with nearly 150,000 accident-free tandem flights in the last 20 years. In the realm of free flight, there is no such thing as a reservation, since we rely on wind conditions. Tandem Flights are sold as a gift certificates and can be used when flying conditions are the best. Paragliding is the more prevalent of the two and allow us to fly in a more diverse range of conditions. The tandem flight program is available seven days a week, 9am - sunset or

blurb: Torrey Pines Gliderport offers tandem paragliding and hang gliding flights daily with experienced pilots. They provide structured training programs for paragliding certification levels P1 through P4 and powered paragliding certification. The site also features equipment sales and service for flight gear.
